question: **Type:** direction-and-sign Which reasoning choice is most reliable when analyzing the energy momentum relation in modern physics special relativity?

options.text: Declare a convention and keep it through every step
Use direction words without defining an axis

explanation: Declare a convention and keep it through every step because it connects the physical definition to evidence and preserves the stated assumptions.
